rca_of_issue: Verification-only iteration. Iter14 root cause: root .gitignore had generic 'node_modules/' rule that matched intermediate path 'frontend/dist/assets/node_modules/' (bundled Expo vector-icon font glyphs), causing 37/41 dist files to be silently ignored despite whitelist. Fix combined two mechanisms: (a) made root node_modules rules path-specific to /node_modules, /frontend/node_modules/, /backend/node_modules/ so the substring 'node_modules' inside dist stops matching; (b) added nested /app/frontend/dist/.gitignore with '!*' '!**' '!.gitignore' — a nested .gitignore's un-ignore rules take precedence over ancestor ignore rules for its own scope, providing a defense-in-depth guarantee. Verified via `git check-ignore` returning exit 1 for the Ionicons.ttf font path and exit 0 (still ignored) for frontend/node_modules/react/package.json.
